title: Annual Tax on Enveloped Dwellings Returns Notice
text: This notice explains how and when you need to submit an Annual Tax on an Enveloped Dwellings ( ATED ) return.
changeNote: Section 3.8 has been added to clarify that only a full ATED return can supersede an HMRC determination.
